notes: Forward-facing walk cycle. Bunny moves toward camera. Used by drawArenaBunny when player walks down (dy>0.5, |dx|<0.4). Sheet has 37 filled cells but the walk gait peaks every ~10-11 frames; frame 32's pose matches frame 0 exactly (bbox xL=80, w=159), so the loop is trimmed to 32 frames (3 full step cycles) — using 37 would hop mid-stride back to wide-cape pose and read as a visible hiccup.
